work.title: Redwood front-door ingestion and UX acceptance path

intent.productGoal: Enable a professional user to create a new engagement and bring unfamiliar evidence through the product UI into a governed canonical engagement.
intent.capability: New engagement, ZIP intake, source inventory/recognition/preview, mapping, G1, immutable run creation, and Reconcile handoff.
architecturalIntent: Existing Redwood Workbench remains the only application surface.
Truth oracle remains outside normal ingestion.
invariants: Original source bytes and hashes remain preserved.
Visible active-engagement values derive from uploaded evidence.
acceptanceEvidence: UX assessment and downloaded workbook hash.

observedBehaviour: Browser run 25a549c1-e42a-4cab-a2de-6a1fc3ad2d14 completed from the original ZIP through staged intake and explicit Run Redwood.
All eight Challenge A truth controls matched after run freeze, including bank total and ERA-to-bank difference.
Validation_Truth was excluded from canonical ingestion.

evidence.result: Browser journey, truth comparison, workbook hash and UX assessment recorded.

evidence.reference: pnpm build && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test
evidence.result: Build/typecheck passed and 20 core tests passed.

divergences.expected: Action Required contains only materially relevant mapping decisions.
divergences.observed: Some operational/provenance fields remain in the Action Required queue.
